#!/bin/bash
# Managed by gryonixNexus — remove services or the whole gryonixNexus install.
# Usage: gryonixnexus-uninstall.sh <service|vpn|--all> [--purge-data] [--purge-backups]
# Default keeps data and backups on disk; the flags delete them (independently).
set -euo pipefail

TARGET="${1:-}"
PURGE_DATA=0
PURGE_BACKUPS=0
shift || true
for arg in "$@"; do
  case "$arg" in
    --purge-data) PURGE_DATA=1 ;;
    --purge-backups) PURGE_BACKUPS=1 ;;
  esac
done

compose_down() {
  if [ "$PURGE_DATA" -eq 1 ]; then
    # --rmi local also reclaims the images, but only the ones THIS
    # project's services use — the scoped replacement for the
    # `docker system prune -af` that used to run once at the end and
    # took every unused image and stopped container on the host with
    # it, ours or not. Images still referenced elsewhere are skipped
    # by docker itself.
    docker compose -p "$1" down --remove-orphans --volumes --rmi local >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  else
    docker compose -p "$1" down --remove-orphans >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi
}

# Removes one site block from the Caddyfile. The header is the exact
# first line of the block as writeCaddyfile emits it (top-level `}` on
# its own line closes it) — wrapper and Caddyfile are regenerated
# together on every setup run, so the format cannot drift between them.
remove_caddy_site() {
  local f=/etc/caddy/Caddyfile
  [ -f "$f" ] || return 0
  awk -v start="$1 {" '
    $0 == start {skip=1; next}
    skip && $0 == "}" {skip=0; next}
    !skip {print}
  ' "$f" > "$f.gryonixnexus" && mv "$f.gryonixnexus" "$f"
  systemctl reload caddy 2>/dev/null || true
}

# Drops exactly the sudoers lines named — baked in by the generator
# from the SAME sudoersLines a service was whitelisted with, never
# rediscovered here. Staged and validated with visudo, the same way
# the whitelist is written: a set of lines that fails to parse (should
# never happen — they are asked in the format already on disk) leaves
# the whitelist untouched rather than risk one sudo cannot read.
remove_sudoers_lines() {
  local f=/etc/sudoers.d/gryonixnexus-control
  [ -f "$f" ] || return 0
  local tmp="$f.gryonixnexus"
  printf '%s\n' "$@" | grep -vFxf - "$f" > "$tmp" || true
  if [ -s "$tmp" ] && visudo -cf "$tmp" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    mv "$tmp" "$f"
  else
    rm -f "$tmp"
  fi
}

uninstall_vaultwarden() {
  compose_down 'vaultwarden'
  remove_caddy_site 'vault.example.com'
  rm -f /opt/vaultwarden-update.sh /opt/vaultwarden-update.sh.bak.* || true
  if [ "$PURGE_DATA" -eq 1 ]; then
    rm -rf '/opt/vaultwarden'
    rm -rf '/opt/vaultwarden/data'
    rm -rf '/opt/vaultwarden/data.pre-restore-'*
  fi
  if [ "$PURGE_BACKUPS" -eq 1 ]; then
    rm -rf '/opt/backups/vaultwarden'
  fi
  remove_sudoers_lines \
    'admin ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/docker restart vaultwarden' \
    'admin ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/docker start vaultwarden' \
    'admin ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/docker stop vaultwarden' \
    'admin ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /bin/tar czf /opt/backups/vaultwarden/vaultwarden-backup.tar.gz -C / opt/vaultwarden/data' \
    'admin ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /bin/chown admin /opt/backups/vaultwarden/vaultwarden-backup.tar.gz' \
    'admin ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/docker logs --tail 500 --timestamps vaultwarden'
}

uninstall_nextcloud() {
  compose_down 'nextcloud'
  remove_caddy_site 'files.example.com'
  if [ "$PURGE_DATA" -eq 1 ]; then
    rm -rf '/opt/nextcloud'
    rm -rf '/opt/nextcloud/data.pre-restore-'*
  fi
  if [ "$PURGE_BACKUPS" -eq 1 ]; then
    rm -rf '/opt/backups/nextcloud'
  fi
  remove_sudoers_lines \
    'admin ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/docker compose -p nextcloud ps' \
    'admin ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/docker compose -p nextcloud restart' \
    'admin ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/docker compose -p nextcloud start' \
    'admin ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/docker compose -p nextcloud stop' \
    'admin ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/docker compose -p nextcloud logs --tail 500 --timestamps'
}

uninstall_adguard_home() {
  compose_down 'adguardhome'
  remove_caddy_site 'dns.example.com'
  if [ "$PURGE_DATA" -eq 1 ]; then
    rm -rf '/opt/adguardhome'
    rm -rf '/opt/adguardhome/conf.pre-restore-'*
  fi
  if [ "$PURGE_BACKUPS" -eq 1 ]; then
    rm -rf '/opt/backups/adguard-home'
  fi
  remove_sudoers_lines \
    'admin ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/docker restart adguardhome' \
    'admin ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/docker start adguardhome' \
    'admin ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/docker stop adguardhome' \
    'admin ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/docker logs --tail 500 --timestamps adguardhome'
}

uninstall_vpn() {
  ip link delete wgpanel 2>/dev/null || true
  compose_down 'vpnpanel'
  remove_caddy_site 'vpn.example.com'
  rm -f /opt/gryonixnexus-admin-lockdown.sh
  : > /etc/caddy/gryonixnexus-admin-guard 2>/dev/null || true
  systemctl reload caddy 2>/dev/null || true
  if [ "$PURGE_DATA" -eq 1 ]; then
    rm -rf '/opt/gryonix-vpn-panel'
    rm -rf '/opt/gryonix-vpn-panel/data.pre-restore-'*
  fi
  if [ "$PURGE_BACKUPS" -eq 1 ]; then
    rm -rf '/opt/backups/vpn-panel'
  fi
  remove_sudoers_lines \
    'admin ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/docker restart vpnpanel' \
    'admin ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/docker logs --tail 500 --timestamps vpnpanel' \
    'admin ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/docker start vpnpanel' \
    'admin ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/docker stop vpnpanel' \
    'admin ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /opt/gryonixnexus-admin-lockdown.sh'
}

uninstall_all() {
  uninstall_vaultwarden
  uninstall_nextcloud
  uninstall_adguard_home
  uninstall_vpn
  # Scheduled updates: the timer is armed by set-schedule, not by
  # setup, so it outlives the services unless it is stopped here.
  systemctl disable --now 'gryonixnexus-autoupdate.timer' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  rm -f /etc/systemd/system/gryonixnexus-autoupdate.timer /etc/systemd/system/gryonixnexus-autoupdate.service
  rm -f '/etc/gryonixnexus/autoupdate.conf' '/var/lib/gryonixnexus/autoupdate-status.txt'
  rm -f '/opt/gryonixnexus-update-ctl.sh'
  # Scheduled backups: the timer is armed by set-schedule, not by
  # setup, so it outlives the services unless it is stopped here.
  systemctl disable --now 'gryonixnexus-autobackup.timer' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  rm -f /etc/systemd/system/gryonixnexus-autobackup.timer /etc/systemd/system/gryonixnexus-autobackup.service
  rm -f '/opt/gryonixnexus-backup-ctl.sh'
  rm -rf '/etc/gryonixnexus'
  # Dynamic DNS: the timer is armed by the panel long after setup,
  # so it outlives the services unless it is stopped here.
  systemctl disable --now 'gryonixnexus-ddns.timer' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  rm -f /etc/systemd/system/gryonixnexus-ddns.timer /etc/systemd/system/gryonixnexus-ddns.service
  rm -f '/etc/gryonixnexus/ddns.conf' '/var/lib/gryonixnexus/ddns-status.txt'
  rm -f '/opt/gryonixnexus-ddns.sh'
  # Control-plane agent: installed by its own bootstrap, outside this
  # setup, and therefore invisible to everything else here. Stopped
  # before the state directory below is removed — the unit's
  # StateDirectory= re-creates it on every start.
  if [ -f /etc/systemd/system/gryonixnexusd.service ]; then
    systemctl disable --now 'gryonixnexusd.service' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    rm -f '/etc/systemd/system/gryonixnexusd.service'
    systemctl daemon-reload || true
  fi
  rm -f '/usr/local/bin/gryonixnexusd' '/run/gryonixnexusd.sock'
  rm -rf '/var/lib/gryonixnexus/agent'
  # The daemon before the rename (gryonixd). install-agent.sh removes
  # it, but a host that never re-ran the bootstrap still has it, and
  # its unit is Restart=always too.
  if [ -f /etc/systemd/system/gryonixnexus.service ]; then
    systemctl disable --now 'gryonixnexus.service' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    rm -f '/etc/systemd/system/gryonixnexus.service'
    systemctl daemon-reload || true
  fi
  rm -f '/usr/local/bin/gryonixd' '/run/gryonixd.sock'
  # Host metrics collector + its history
  systemctl disable --now gryonixnexus-metrics >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  rm -f /etc/systemd/system/gryonixnexus-metrics.service /opt/gryonixnexus-metrics-collector.sh
  systemctl daemon-reload || true
  rm -rf /var/lib/gryonixnexus
  # The Caddy ingress is entirely ours
  systemctl disable --now caddy >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  rm -f /etc/caddy/Caddyfile '/etc/caddy/gryonixnexus-admin-guard'

  # No host-wide `docker system prune` here: image reclamation is done
  # per compose project by compose_down --rmi local, which cannot
  # reach Docker state this deployment did not create.
  # Dashboard wrappers, then our own whitelist last — after this line
  # the app's sudo access is gone, which is the point.
  rm -f '/opt/gryonixnexus-container-ctl.sh' '/opt/gryonixnexus-restore.sh'
  # The agent bootstrap wrapper and whatever sources it unpacked. A
  # root-owned script the erase leaves behind is the DDNS lesson: the
  # erased machine still carrying something only root can remove.
  rm -f '/opt/gryonixnexus-agent-bootstrap.sh'
  rm -rf '/opt/gryonixnexus-agent-src'
  # Backup copies the setup makes before overwriting a managed file.
  rm -f /etc/nftables.conf.bak.* /etc/wireguard/wg0.conf.bak.* /etc/systemd/system/gryonixnexus-*.service.bak.* /opt/gryonixnexus-*.bak.* /opt/vaultwarden-update.sh.bak.* /etc/caddy/Caddyfile.bak.* /etc/systemd/system/gryonixnexus-*.timer.bak.* /etc/sysctl.d/99-gryonixnexus-rpfilter.conf.bak.* || true
  # SSH password login comes back BEFORE the app key is stripped below,
  # so this machine is never left with neither way in.
  rm -f /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/10-gryonixnexus-no-password.conf
  systemctl reload ssh 2>/dev/null || systemctl reload sshd 2>/dev/null || true
  APP_KEY='ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIFakeFakeFakeFakeFakeFakeFakeFakeFakeFakeFake gryonixnexus-app'
  USER_HOME="$(getent passwd 'admin' | cut -d: -f6 || true)"
  if [ -n "$USER_HOME" ] && [ -f "$USER_HOME/.ssh/authorized_keys" ]; then
    grep -vxF "$APP_KEY" "$USER_HOME/.ssh/authorized_keys" > "$USER_HOME/.ssh/authorized_keys.gryonixnexus" || true
    mv "$USER_HOME/.ssh/authorized_keys.gryonixnexus" "$USER_HOME/.ssh/authorized_keys"
    chmod 600 "$USER_HOME/.ssh/authorized_keys"
    # Root wrote the replacement, and sshd reads authorized_keys as
    # the account: leaving it root-owned makes the file unreadable to
    # sshd and kills every OTHER key the account has. Same reason the
    # revoke step chowns; see revokeInstallKey.
    chown 'admin' "$USER_HOME/.ssh/authorized_keys"
  fi
  rm -f /etc/sudoers.d/gryonixnexus-control
  rm -f '/opt/gryonixnexus-uninstall.sh'
}

case "$TARGET" in
  vaultwarden) uninstall_vaultwarden ;;
  nextcloud) uninstall_nextcloud ;;
  adguard-home) uninstall_adguard_home ;;
  vpn) uninstall_vpn ;;
  --all) uninstall_all ;;
  *) echo "unsupported target: ${TARGET}" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
echo 'GRYONIXNEXUS_UNINSTALL_DONE'
